papers.title: Transcriptomic, Specific Marker, and Pathway Analysis of Smooth Muscle Cell Foam Cells Relative to Macrophage Foam Cells in Human Atherosclerosis
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Smooth muscle cells (SMCs) are reported to contribute the majority of cholesterol-overloaded foam cells in human and mouse atheromas. However, the transcriptome, specific markers, and biologic itinerary of SMC foam cells relative to macrophage foam cells have not been determined. METHODS: Transcriptomic analysis by single cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) was performed on fresh coronary segments from heart transplant recipients with early to intermediate stage atherosclerosis. The gene expression pattern of a putative cluster of SMC foam cells was compared to those of cultured SMCs loaded with either aggregated low density lipoprotein (agLDL) or cholesterol bound to methyl-beta-cyclodextrin (Chol-MBCD). Candidate markers of SMC foam cells not expressed by macrophage foam cells were validated in ours and publicly available datasets, by spatial transcriptomics and by immunofluorescence microscopy of human atheromas. Pathway analysis was performed using Gene Set Enrichment Analysis Hallmark gene sets. RESULTS: SMC foam cells derived from fibromyocytes were tentatively identified using a panel of markers upregulated with in vitro cholesterol loading of SMCs. agLDL loading reproduced the same transcriptional profile, whereas Chol-MBCD did not reproduce any in vivo SMC state. Top genes highly represented in SMC foam cells included SERPINE1, encoding plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 (PAI-1) and CFH, complement factor H, which were validated in further human coronary scRNA-seq datasets, by Xenium spatial transcriptomics, and by immunofluorescence microscopy. Relative to macrophage foam cells, SMC foam cells exhibit a distinct biologic itinerary, including activation of extracellular matrix, coagulation and angiogenesis pathways. CONCLUSIONS: SMC foam cells, which are derived from fibromyocytes ('lipomyocytes'), exhibit unique markers and biologic programs that differ markedly from macrophage foam cells in atherosclerotic plaque development. Further understanding of the role of lipomyocytes and their expression of CFH and PAI-1 expression in plaque biology may offer novel therapeutic options to reduce ischemic cardiovascular disease.

papers.title: LINE-1 insertion intermediates recombine with one another or with DNA breaks to form genome rearrangements
papers.abstract: LINE-1 retrotransposition is associated with genome instability in cancers, yet the mechanisms are not fully understood. Here, the authors combine recombination reporter assays with long-read sequencing to show that retrotransposition intermediates can recombine with one another or with DNA breaks to produce chromosomal rearrangements.
papers.titleZh: LINE-1插入中間體互相重組或與DNA斷裂重組，導致基因體重排
papers.summaryZh: 這項研究揭示了LINE-1反轉錄轉座子如何透過其插入中間體互相重組，或與DNA斷裂點重組，進而產生染色體重排。研究團隊結合重組報導分析與長讀取定序技術，證實這些重組事件是癌症基因體不穩定性的重要來源。此發現有助於理解癌症中常見的結構變異形成機制，並可能為癌症治療提供新標靶。

papers.title: The transcription factor C/EBPβ promotes hyperglycemia-elicited glycolysis and liver cancer progression
papers.abstract: High blood sugar in diabetes is linked to faster cancer growth, but the mechanisms remain unclear. Here, the authors show that the transcription factor C/EBPβ is activated by high glucose to enhance glycolysis and HRAS-driven proliferation, promoting liver cancer progression and revealing a potential therapeutic target.

papers.title: Corisin induces proteostasis stress to drive epithelial injury and pulmonary fibrosis
papers.abstract: Here, the authors establish the naturally occurring microbiota-derived Corisin as a potent driver of lung injury and fibrosis, revealing a previously unrecognized microbial pathway that disrupts epithelial cell function and promotes pulmonary fibrosis.
papers.titleZh: 微生物代謝物Corisin引發蛋白質穩態壓力，驅動肺部損傷與纖維化
papers.summaryZh: 這項研究發現，微生物群衍生的代謝物Corisin是導致肺部損傷與纖維化的關鍵驅動因子。研究團隊證實Corisin會破壞上皮細胞功能，引發蛋白質穩態壓力，進而促進肺纖維化。此發現揭示了一條過去未被認識的微生物途徑，為肺纖維化的治療提供了全新標靶。

papers.title: Ruxolitinib prevents irreversible autoimmune endocrinopathies in APECED
papers.abstract: APECED is a monogenic autoimmune disorder resulting from deleterious variants in the Autoimmune Regulator gene. Here, the authors report the cases of two patients with APECED in whom early intervention with the JAK1/2 inhibitor ruxolitinib prevented endocrine autoimmunity.
papers.titleZh: Ruxolitinib 預防 APECED 患者不可逆的內分泌自體免疫疾病
papers.summaryZh: APECED 是一種由自體免疫調節基因變異引起的單基因自體免疫疾病，常導致多種內分泌腺體受損。本研究報告兩名 APECED 患者，在疾病早期使用 JAK1/2 抑制劑 ruxolitinib 進行干預，成功阻止了內分泌自體免疫的發展。這項發現為 APECED 提供了一種潛在的預防性治療策略，避免患者面臨不可逆的器官損傷。研究結果強調了早期診斷與及時介入的重要性，可能改變此罕見疾病的臨床管理方式。

papers.title: A massively parallel CRISPR-based screening platform for modifiers of neuronal depolarization
papers.abstract: We currently lack scalable approaches to systematically reveal the genetic underpinnings of neuronal function in health and disease. Here, the authors develop a platform to uncover genes affecting neuronal excitability in scalable CRISPR screens.
papers.titleZh: 大規模平行CRISPR篩選平台：揭示神經去極化調控基因
papers.summaryZh: 這項研究開發了一個可大規模平行進行的CRISPR篩選平台，能夠系統性地找出影響神經元興奮性的基因。傳統方法難以全面解析神經功能背後的遺傳機制，而此平台突破了規模限制，可同時測試數千個基因。透過監測神經去極化反應，研究人員能快速鑑定出調控神經元活性的關鍵基因。這項技術為理解神經疾病（如癲癇、疼痛）的遺傳基礎提供了高效工具，並可能加速相關藥物靶點的發現。

paper.title: Where the river turns old: urbanized deltas imprint a fossil signature on black carbon exported to the ocean
paper.abstract: Whether fossil black carbon (BC) biases the 14C age of riverine BC is unclear. This study shows urbanized deltas add fossil BC, making BC 14C age appear much older and underscoring the need for landuse context when estimating BC residence time on land.

paper.title: A molecular velcro self-healing cement
paper.abstract: A “molecular Velcro” cement with trace amounts of polymer rapidly heals cracks through reversible molecular interactions and pore-scale transport, restoring strength across damage cycles and offering a scalable path to longer-lasting concrete.

paper.title: All-small-molecule Hydrogels for Safe and Efficient Photoprotection
paper.abstract: Commercial sunscreens rely on organic and inorganic UV filters that may generate ROS and induce phototoxicity, raising safety concerns. Encapsulation strategies mitigate transdermal penetration but add formulation complexity and cost. Here, the authors introduce carrier-free, all-small-molecule hydrogels formed via one-pot integration of natural polyphenols and aminoglycosides. These materials provide effective UV protection, antioxidant and antibacterial activity, good biosafety, and limited skin penetration, offering a promising, simpler alternative to conventional sunscreens.
